svg.aria-label: Two paths for running a model: an HTTP backend that returns only text, which cannot be lensed, versus an in-process transformers stack with eager attention, per-layer hooks, scalars aggregated in the hook, and FastAPI streaming those scalars to the UI over SSE

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Aggregation happens in the hook, or the numbers never exist

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An 8B residual is about 260 KB per token. A thousand-token answer of raw states is 260 MB. Attention is worse : it grows with seq squared.

svg.text: SDPA and FlashAttention never materialize the attention matrix, so under them the attention collector has nothing to compute from.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weight-only schemes that keep hooks working : GPTQ, AWQ : are fine. GGUF is not: transformers dequantizes it on load, and a 12B checkpoint becomes about 48 GB.
